lockup.summary: The company, its directors and officers, and holders of nearly all its stock cannot sell for at least 180 days after the prospectus date. Goldman Sachs and Jefferies can approve a sale earlier, and some exceptions apply.

what: City Therapeutics is a clinical-stage biotech company developing RNA interference medicines that switch off proteins linked to disease.
proceeds: It expects net proceeds of about $181.5 million. It plans about $30.0 million for CITY-FXI, $20.0 million for CITY-RBP4, $40.0 million for CITY-TFR2 and $70.0 million for its City Platform. The rest goes to working capital and general costs.
risks: The company is young, has no approved products, and has a short history, so it is hard to judge its prospects.
It has never earned revenue from selling drugs, and becoming profitable depends on many things going right.
Its way of finding and developing drugs is new and may never produce products that can be sold.
It has focused on RNAi technology and its City Platform, so its future depends heavily on them working.
Its approach to designing and developing programs is unproven, and it may fail to find product candidates of commercial value.
